iterate_datasets: iterate over all non-deprecated datasets in a Datasets collection in sorted order
lookup_dataset_by_uri: lookup a Dataset by its benchmark URI string using bracket notation on Datasets
enumerate_benchmarks_round_robin: enumerate benchmarks across multiple datasets in stable round robin order using benchmarks()
select_benchmark_by_uri: select a specific Benchmark instance by its full URI string using the benchmark() method
random_benchmark_weighted: select a random benchmark from visible datasets with optional weighted sampling by dataset size
